verses.text: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.

footnotes.text: mighty rock: See the note at 18.2.

verses.text: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
Let the king have a long and healthy life.
May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
